summary: Carlyle Credit Income Fund filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing management's unaudited net asset value per common share of $3.05 as of September 30, 2026. No transaction, shareholder action, or structural event is described; the filing contains no deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor. The registrant is a closed-end credit fund listed on the NYSE under CCIF (common) and CCID (preferred). This is an ordinary NAV disclosure, not a special situation; watch for periodic NAV updates and any discount/premium to market price rather than deal mechanics.
